test_title: PYST 25 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that is the most appropriate conversion of the following sentence into Direct Speech.

He said that while he had been writing the report, his laptop suddenly shut down.

options.text: He said, "While I wrote the report, my laptop suddenly shut down."
He said, "While I was writing the report, my laptop suddenly shut down."
He said, "While I am writing the report, my laptop suddenly shuts down."
He said, "While I had been writing the report, my laptop had shut down."

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. He said, "While I was writing the report, my laptop suddenly shut down."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Reported Speech**, which needs to be converted into **Direct Speech**.
 
• In the Direct Speech format, the tense used depends on the context and the tense of the original statement.
 
• From the sentence in Reported Speech:
 
 
• Original tense: "had been writing" (past perfect continuous) → converted to "was writing" (past continuous) for Direct Speech.
 
• The event "laptop suddenly shut down" is in simple past tense ("shut down").
 
 
 
• Option 2 correctly reflects the tense consistency and retains the original meaning of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *He said, "While I was writing the report, my laptop suddenly shut down."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct Speech:**
 
 
• Direct Speech is used to quote the exact words of the speaker.
 
• It is enclosed in quotation marks (" ").
 
• Example: He said, "I am going to the market."
 
 
 
• **Reported Speech:**
 
 
• Reported Speech is used to convey the meaning of what the speaker said, without quoting their exact words.
 
• It typically involves a shift in tense and no quotation marks.
 
• Example: He said that he was going to the market.
